_note: PLACEHOLDER DATA for most garment_flat brands below — structurally realistic but NOT verified against official size guides; several Indian D2C brands' size charts are rendered in JS-based 'Fit Guide' tabs that aren't crawlable, confirmed across Pantaloons, Zudio, and The Souled Store. Westside's body_circumference data IS sourced from Westside's real official size guide. Attempting to verify the remaining brands surfaced a structural finding, not just a data gap: most brands — including large global ones like Uniqlo (confirmed on Uniqlo's own official size-chart help pages) — don't publish one canonical brand-wide chart at all; measurements are given per product/style, since cut varies style to style. This file's schema (one chart per brand) is therefore a simplification of how sizing actually works, not just unverified data entry. See open-questions.md for the follow-up. Units: cm.
